For our group trip of 10 to Udaipur, Nathdwara, and Kumbhalgarh, Alpa from Travel Destinations handled everything with a lot of patience and calm. She really took the time to understand what I wanted, was open to multiple changes, and never pushed standard plans. Recommendation:
If you value thoughtful planning, comfort, and a truly personalized approach—especially for group travel—I would definitely recommend Alpa. She listens, understands, and delivers with genuine care.

The hotels were all 4* & they were all upto the standards. Staffs were very sweet and helpful. Warm welcome and prompt service. Rooms weeeWe being a vegetarian didn't face any issues with food. All hotels had a huge option for vegetarian and non veg too. Our trip was very smooth & memorable. Weather was pleasant and favourable at all times. So many places to explore n so many speciaities of kerala like banana chips, ayurveda farm, spices n much more. All organic and natural. Would like to visit again and again. Such a beautiful city full of natural beauty n products. The driver took us to all reasonable outlets for shopping also to good authentic massage centre. Overall I highly recommend Alpa from travel destinations for all ur trips within India and outside India. They have very good service and has personal touch to ensure everything is perfect. Any feedback and grievances are handled in positive manners which makes it even more approachable n great.
Thanks once again
Kavitha Vijay
Singapore

Absolutely Shameful & Worst Travel Experience – Travel Bazaar Global (Mumbai)

Shame on Travel Bazaar Global for the mental harassment and last-minute panic they caused my family before our Thailand trip (22–31 Jan 2026). After taking 50% advance, their responsiveness dropped drastically. Calls were ignored, WhatsApp messages were seen but not replied to, and no proper documentation was shared despite repeated follow-ups.

Even after paying 100% of the amount (only after their repeated assurances), flight tickets were issued just 4–5 hours before departure. Imagine the stress of preparing for an international trip without confirmed PNR until the last moment. Hotels were also booked only hours before check-in.

The team kept passing responsibility to each other and giving excuses like “server issues.” There was no single point of contact, no accountability, and zero professionalism.

We were also asked to book cabs during the trip with a refund promise — but when we requested reimbursement, they stopped responding completely.

This company caused unnecessary anxiety, chaos, and emotional distress. Please think multiple times and verify everything before trusting them with your hard-earned money.
